blocks.text: The Department of Labor and Employement (DOLE) said it has found labor violations committed by M/V June Aster owner Atienza Interisland Ferries Inc. after the agency conducted a hearing on Thursday following the fire that razed the ship off Coron, Palawan last September 9.
